mentions.name: 5QL
mentions.description: 5QL is a visual SQL exploration tool that lets users select columns and drill down to create joins, with editing the SQL text updating the view live.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on an new approach to working with SQL:
https://5QL.site

You select columns and then just drill down to create further joins. Change the SQL text and it updates the view.
